To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

acute and chronic supplementation with 280 mL of beetroot juice per day did not reduce sub‐maximal oxygen uptake or improve aerobic performance in recreationally‐active females despite increasing low‐frequency torque production of the plantar‐flexors.
Acute and chronic supplementation with beetroot juice did not improve time trial performance or exercise economy in recreationally active women.
